text: I'm so sorry to bother you at this time of night. I'm a foster carer and I've had a baby boy placed with me, he's 6 months old, and I'm honestly a bit shaken. I noticed a rash on his tummy and back when I changed him for bed, little red blotchy bits. I've read so much scary stuff about rashes that my heart was pounding, but I remembered the glass test and pressed the side of a glass on it and it does go pale and fade every time, I tried it in a few places. I took his temperature too and it was 37.9. I know that's not very high but because he's not my own baby and I don't know his history very well I feel like I'm second guessing everything. I've only had him a couple of weeks and I want to do the right thing for him and also I have to report anything to his social worker so I want to be sure I'm not missing something. Is this something that can be looked at by a GP tomorrow or should I be doing something tonight? Thank you, sorry it's long, I'm just a bit panicky.
